title: On-Time Payment Record Wear Credit for Kestrel Advantage Balloon Returns
content:
A customer returning a vehicle under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract with a clean recent payment record receives an on-time wear credit against the excess wear charge. The record is measured in whole calendar months from the due date of the installment that drew the most recent balloon late charge to the return date.

| Whole calendar months from that due date to the return date | Wear credit |
|---|---|
| At least 9, or no balloon late charge has ever been assessed | USD 100.00 |
| At least 6 but fewer than 9 | USD 50.00 |
| Fewer than 6 | None |

**Which late charge.** The most recent balloon late charge is the one with the latest assessment date in the contract's posting history; of two balloon late charges assessed the same day, the one recorded first is taken as the most recent. The months run from that charge's installment due date, not from the day it was assessed.

**Counting months.** Whole calendar months from one date to another are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.

## Hypothetical cases (return on 10 October)

- Most recent late charge on the installment due 10 January of that year: 9 whole months, USD 100.00.
- On the installment due 11 January: 8 whole months, USD 50.00.
- On the installment due 11 April: 5 whole months, none.
- No late charge ever: USD 100.00.
